correctness.rationale: The final theorem is correct for fixed real n>=2 and 1<=k<n. In graph coordinates T around any maximizing coordinate plane, rows of T are inside the l1 unit ball, giving the EXACT local shadow ratio det(I+T^T T)^(-1/2). Ivanov’s sharp equality characterization and Grassmannian compactness localize all sufficiently high-volume events to disjoint such charts. The Gaussian/Stiefel block determinant is a product of independent Beta((k-i+1)/2,(n-k)/2) variables in square; moment determinacy on [0,1] supplies equality of laws. The normalized matrix-t graph density, uniform polar expansion, Wick trace-four moment E tr[(W^TW)^2]=(n+1)/(k(n-k)+2), and sphere integration yield the stated gamma constant and correction k(n-k)(k-2)(n-k-2)/(4(k(n-k)+2)). Complementation sends T to -T^T, and Sylvester’s determinant identity proves the EXACT near-endpoint event identity after choosing a common small neighborhood. Independent calculations checked the gamma symmetry, low-dimensional moment identities and linear correction for 55 dimension pairs. Finite tests do not independently prove Ivanov’s global maximizing-set theorem, which is a cited input. ε0 is existential and the asymptotic is not dimension uniform.
